data.name: Budhia
data.gender_notes: Budhia is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Budhia is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Budh', meaning intellect, knowledge, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Budha is the planet Mercury, symbolizing intelligence, communication, and knowledge. This name is given to children believed to possess a sharp mind and the potential for great learning. The name Budhia carries the meaning “Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Budhia usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine intelligence and knowledge.
data.etymology: Budhia belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Budhia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
